title: Reedy realization transfers combinatorial prism homotopies
statement: Use the simplicial model-category, simplicial tensor, Reedy model-structure, simplex-category, and combinatorial simplicial-homotopy notions of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization], [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], and [lem-coef-simplicial-extra-degeneracy-prism]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a simplicial model category and let $X_\bullet,Y_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal M$ be Reedy-cofibrant. For any simplicial object $Z_\bullet$ define its tensor realization by $$|Z_\bullet|=\operatorname{coeq}\left(\coprod_{\alpha:[m]\to[n]} Z_n\otimes\Delta^m\rightrightarrows\coprod_{n\geq0}Z_n\otimes\Delta^n\right),$$ where $\Delta^n=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta(-,[n])$, and the parallel arrows use $Z(\alpha)$ and $\Delta^\alpha$, respectively. Then $|X_\bullet|$ is cofibrant, and $P_X=|X_\bullet|\otimes\Delta^1$, with vertex maps $i_0,i_1:|X_\bullet|\to P_X$ and projection $p:P_X\to |X_\bullet|$ induced by $\Delta^1\to\Delta^0$, is a cylinder object: $p i_0=p i_1=1$, $p$ is a weak equivalence, and $i_0\amalg i_1:|X_\bullet|\amalg|X_\bullet|\to P_X$ is a cofibration. For maps $u,v:X_\bullet\to Y_\bullet$, every combinatorial simplicial homotopy from $u$ to $v$ induces a map $\widetilde H:P_X\to |Y_\bullet|$ with $\widetilde H i_0=|u|$ and $\widetilde H i_1=|v|$. Tensor notation $Z\otimes K$ denotes the chosen tensor $K\otimes Z$.

source.place: Dugger, A Primer on Homotopy Colimits, formula (3.2), printed p.9; skeletal pushout in the proof of Theorem 3.5, printed pp.10-11; Section 19.1, printed p.90. Read online on 2026-10-17; not archived. These give the coend and the cofibrancy method, not the exact combinatorial-prism theorem. The prism formulation is agent-written; no Stacks tag states it.
